1. (Currently amended) A golf tee comprising a long lasting combination of a golf tee and a force absorbing member in association therewith, said tee including a ground insertion end, a ball support end and a shaft in between, said member surrounding said shaft and being located below said ball support end and having an outer diameter less than that of a golf ball but large enough and located so as to protect said support end from impact from a golf club strike after a golf ball has been struck from said tee, wherein said force absorbing member is __permanently affixed to said shaft__.

2. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a material that enables the shaft to withstand damage from a strike on the resilient member __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material having a durometer hardness of less than 30 or greater than 90__.

3. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a member selected from the group consisting of wood, plastic and metal, __and wherein the force absorbing member is formed from a material different from the material of the tee__.

4. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a hardwood __and wherein said force absorbing member comprises a resilient elastomer__.

5. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from an engineering plastic __having a Shore D hardness of at least 80__, and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material softer than the tee material.

6. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 5, wherein said tee is formed from a polycarbonate __having a Shore D hardness of at least 80__.

7. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from nylon __having a Shore D hardness of at least 80__, and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material softer than the tee material.

8. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a malleable metal __and wherein said force absorbing member comprises a resilient elastomer permanently affixed to the metal shaft__.

10. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 9, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising __an elastomer selected from the group consisting of natural rubber, synthetic rubber, and silicone rubber__.
